Liam Dawson to Matt Renshaw, THATS OUT!! Caught&Bowled!!

Liam Dawson to Matt Renshaw, out Caught&Bowled!! Smashed straight back to the bowler. This was really brave of Liam Dawson to switch to round the wicket. The moment LHBs face the left arm orthodox, they back themselves to attack every single time, more so from round the wicket. Dawson darts this full, Renshaw looks to drill hard, doesn't get under it properly so it goes flat and straight. Dawson moves to the right, gets low and grabs a great reflex catch. Runs off in his celebration, before throwing the ball high. So not a third life for Renshaw. Matt Renshaw c and b Liam Dawson 55(70) [4s-6]
